title: The Radioactive Fruit in Your Kitchen
hook: A single banana releases a burst of pure antimatter every ninety minutes.
script: A single banana releases a burst of pure antimatter every ninety minutes. So how many bananas would you eat before the radiation becomes fatal? Each one delivers 0.1 microsieverts of radiation from an isotope called potassium-40. Cargo containers full of bananas regularly trigger nuclear alarms at border checkpoints. Eating forty-two bananas at once stops your heart from potassium toxicity long before radiation matters. Your own body is even more radioactive, firing potassium-40 decays 5,000 times a second. This isotope has decayed since Earth formed, outlasting human history eighty thousand times over. Your kidneys flush the extra dose, leaving you glowing quietly in the dark.
